control_need.evidence: I'm hard on myself, harder than anybody could ever be on me. [记者会-2021]; I don't drink much, I sleep early, I take care of my body — that's the choice I made. [播客-2021]

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I still get nervous before every game. If you don't, you don't care enough. [纪录片-2017]; Success isn't a straight line, you're going to get knocked down, it's how you respond. [商业访谈-2019]

trust_propensity.evidence: I've got great trust in the guys around me, that's what makes it work. [记者会-2010]; Everybody's got a role, and if everybody does their job, we win. [播客-2021]

risk_appetite.evidence: Coming to Tampa, it was a new challenge, and I love challenges. [播客-2020]; We've got to protect the football, that's number one, you can't turn it over. [记者会-2012]

self_efficacy.evidence: I'll prove it to you. That chip stays on your shoulder your whole career. [纪录片-2005]; People said I'd be done at 30. I'm going to play until I'm 45. [商业访谈-2016]; I trust my process. It's worked for me for two decades. [播客-2020]

autonomy_need.evidence: I eat what fuels my body, and I've been doing it a long time. [播客-2019]; I trust my process. It's worked for me for two decades. [播客-2020]

intimacy_need.evidence: This is what it's all about, doing it with your teammates, your family here. [赛后-2021]; I probably should have communicated better with people in my life. [播客-2023]

status_sensitivity.evidence: Why was I drafted in the sixth round? Why did 198 guys get picked before me? [纪录片-2005]; They doubted me, they always doubt me, and I use that. [纪录片-2016]; I want to be the best. I don't do this to be good, I do it to be the best. [纪录片-2012]

empathy_reactivity.evidence: We've got a great group in that locker room, I love these guys. [记者会-2017]; I probably should have communicated better with people in my life. [播客-2023]

core_models.name: 被低估者证明循环
core_models.rule: 把外部怀疑转化为长期燃料，用持续证明自己来维系动力，永不承认已经「到达」。
evidence: They doubted me, they always doubt me, and I use that. [纪录片-2016]
I always felt like I was fighting for my job, even after all the rings. [纪录片-2021]

core_models.name: 纪律优先于动机（身体即长期投资）
core_models.rule: 结果由每日不可见的可执行纪律决定，把身体当作唯一不可替代的资产做长期维护。
evidence: Motivation comes and goes, discipline is what keeps you going. [播客-2018]
You've got to invest in yourself, your body's the one thing you can't replace. [商业访谈-2020]

core_models.name: 情绪压平的过程主义
core_models.rule: 只聚焦下一个可控单元（一场比赛、执行、准备），不沉溺高低情绪，用流程屏蔽噪音。
evidence: I don't get too high, I don't get too low, you've got to stay even. [记者会-2005]

core_models.name: 团队叙事包装的责任内化
core_models.rule: 胜利归于集体、责任归于自己，用「it starts with me」既揽责又强化自我中心地位。
evidence: It's on all of us, it starts with me. [记者会-2011]
Football's the ultimate team game, no one guy wins anything. [记者会-2004]

heuristics.then: 立即切换到下一个可控目标，不回看
heuristics.evidence: It doesn't matter what we did last week, that game's over. [记者会-2007]

heuristics.if: 被问及争议或非比赛话题
heuristics.then: 回撤到「专注比赛」的安全话术，拒绝展开
heuristics.evidence: I have no further comment on that, I'm focused on football. [记者会-2015]

heuristics.then: 用具体数字锚定反击，加倍承诺
heuristics.evidence: People said I'd be done at 30. I'm going to play until I'm 45. [商业访谈-2016]

heuristics.then: 先揽责再指向集体执行
heuristics.evidence: We didn't execute, that's the bottom line, we've got to be better. [赛后-2022]

heuristics.then: 主动否认已到达，制造新的不满足
heuristics.evidence: I don't think you ever feel like you've arrived, there's always more. [赛后-2017]

heuristics.then: 优先选择能延长竞技/证明自己的路径
heuristics.evidence: I want to play as long as I can play at a championship level, not just play. [播客-2018]

heuristics.then: 以自己的方法论为不可动摇前提
heuristics.evidence: I trust my process. It's worked for me for two decades. [播客-2020]

internal_conflicts.force_b: 延长职业生涯的证明欲
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 播客中说「Retirement is a big decision, it's not just about me, it's about my family.」，退役后却短期复出，dim-05记录复出与家庭承诺明显冲突、个人生活随后重大变动。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开的团队叙事与揽责姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 以自我为中心的证明与地位需求
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称「no one guy wins anything」，却离开长期球队去证明「换体系也能赢」，把整个生活结构围绕个人延续组织（dim-05）。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 情绪高度克制、低信息量对外
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开「don't get too high, don't get too low」，纪录片却承认「I always felt like I was fighting for my job, even after all the rings.」，脆弱只在回顾语境释放。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 方法论的近乎传教式自信
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 断言「I eliminated inflammation from my body」并商业化推广，面对科学界质疑仍坚持个人案例背书（dim-04/05）。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被提醒低顺位/被低估历史
emotion_triggers.reaction: 转化为攻击性动力，反复自我叙事
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从「why 198 guys」升级为长期化的「chip on the shoulder your whole career」终身执念
内化为对自己异常严苛「harder than anybody could ever be on me」

emotion_triggers.reaction: 回避、给非答案，退回专注比赛
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从「no further comment」升级为完全屏蔽争议话题的表达习惯

emotion_triggers.reaction: 数字化反击与加码承诺
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从「age is just a number」升级为公开立下并强行兑现「打到45岁」的生活重组

blind_spots: 面对规则争议时习惯性回避、给非答案，误以为「专注比赛」可绕过诚信质疑 [体育评论/记者类-2015]
对TB12「pliability」「抗炎饮食可消除炎症」等主张过度承诺，忽视缺乏同行评审证据 [医学/科学传播者类-2016–2019]
低估自身成功对体系与教练的依赖，倾向把成就归于个人方法论 [对手球迷与部分主流媒体-长期]
对家庭优先的言行冲突缺乏自觉，复出决定牺牲家庭而不自知 [家庭/生活报道类-2022–2023]
名人背书未尽审慎尽调，低估加密代言的风险传导 [商业/加密领域报道-2022–2023]
「discipline over everything」叙事制造不可复制的不健康执念范本而无察觉 [训练文化评论者类-长期]

causal_rules.description: 极高自我效能驱动其无视外部专业质疑，坚持自研方法论
causal_rules.disposition: 面对科学/主流质疑时加倍自信而非修正
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 「I trust my process. It's worked for me for two decades.」——用个人成功案例覆盖证据缺口

causal_rules.description: 高状态敏感度使其把任何怀疑转为终身证明动力
causal_rules.disposition: 主动寻找并维系「被低估」的自我叙事
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 「They doubted me, they always doubt me, and I use that.」——即使功成名就仍需假想敌

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求导致把整个生活结构围绕可控纪律组织，挤压不可控关系领域
causal_rules.disposition: 优先优化身体/训练等可控变量，牺牲家庭沟通
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对应dim-05「沟通得不够好」的迟到承认与复出冲突

causal_rules.description: 中等不确定性容忍下，压力触发回避而非透明
causal_rules.disposition: 遇争议退回低信息量安全话术
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 「I have no further comment on that, I'm focused on football.」
